title: OpenStax presents the second law as its own chapter
summary: College Physics 2e, section 15.3, is a textbook statement of the second law, not a primary paper.
body: OpenStax College Physics 2e, section 15.3, is titled "Introduction to the Second Law of Thermodynamics: Heat Engines and Their Efficiency." The v1 article's examples (ice melting, perfume spreading, an unbaked cake) are classroom illustrations of irreversibility. This card only records that a standard open textbook treats the second law as a distinct principle about the direction of thermal processes. The fetched page text did not include a single equation we are willing to retype as if it had been checked symbol by symbol.
